slides.texte_overlay: exquisite words to add to your vocabulary

ineffable
adjective — too great to be described in words
"the joy of finishing my last exam was ineffable."

erudite
adjective — having or showing great knowledge
"her essay was so erudite the teacher read it aloud."

laconic
adjective — using very few words
"his laconic answer: "done.""

sanguine
adjective — optimistic, even in a difficult situation
"she stayed sanguine about the retake."

halcyon
adjective — calm, peaceful and happy (often about the past)
"the halcyon days before exam season."
